exec: pm.test('Health payload is an object', () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('Health message identifies backend', () => pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Backend is running'));
pm.test('Incomplete signup explains required fields', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Name, email, and password are required'));
pm.test('Empty signup reports required fields', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Name, email, and password are required'));
pm.test('Signup returns confirmation message', () => pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('User created successfully'));
pm.test('Signup returns a numeric user id', () => pm.expect(body.user.id).to.be.a('number'));
pm.test('Duplicate signup identifies existing email', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Email already exists'));
pm.test('Incomplete login explains required fields', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Email and password are required'));
pm.test('Invalid login uses safe generic error', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Unknown email login returns HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Unknown email uses safe generic error', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Missing JWT has an authorization message', () => pm.expect(body.msg).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);
pm.test('Valid JWT user lookup returns HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('User lookup returns account creation timestamp', () => pm.expect(body.user.created_at).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);
pm.test('Malformed history JWT returns HTTP 422', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Malformed history JWT returns parser message', () => pm.expect(body.msg).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);
pm.test('History save returns confirmation', () => pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('History saved'));
const match = body.history.find((entry) => entry.feature_data && entry.feature_data.marker === marker);
pm.test('History retrieval contains saved marker', () => pm.expect(match).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('Translation lists missing fields', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Text, from_lang, and to_lang are required'));
pm.test('Missing source language returns HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Missing source language uses field validation error', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Text, from_lang, and to_lang are required'));
pm.test('Missing target language returns HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('Missing target language uses field validation error', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Text, from_lang, and to_lang are required'));
pm.test('Same-language translation explains conflict', () => pm.expect(body.error).to.eql('Source and target languages must be different'));
